pages.text:
A Hardened machine that crushes Graphite into Diamonds between tungsten anvils.
- 4 Graphite make a Diamond, for 2,000,000 FE and 240,000 HU over a minute.
- It only works at 1,400°C or hotter, and heat only flows from something hotter: a Fuel Burner or Firebox on oxy-fuel, or a Firebox Array burning Coal Coke with oxygen.
- Graphite comes from Coal Coke (or 2 Carbon Dust) baked at 1,500°C in the Arcforge Furnace.
- Graphite in on top, Diamonds out underneath, heat into the left, FE into the back. Speed, Energy and Heat upgrades.
